name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, during his mandatory military service. Assigned to a vehicle maintenance unit, he discovered a natural aptitude for working with advanced materials, particularly composites. After his service, he pursued formal training in materials engineering and specialized in composite fabrication. He honed his skills in the aerospace industry before transitioning to motorsport, drawn by the challenge of pushing composite technology to its limits.

Jae-Hyun is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality. He believes that the key to success in composite technology is a deep understanding of the materials at hand and relentless attention to detail. He doesn't shy away from problem-solving and constantly seeks innovative solutions to improve the performance and durability of racing components. He is a valuable asset to Crown Racing, bringing a wealth of knowledge and a calm, steady hand to the team.

What makes Jae-Hyun distinctive is his quiet dedication and unwavering loyalty. He is not one to seek the spotlight, preferring to let his work speak for itself. His colleagues appreciate his willingness to share his knowledge and his unwavering support, even under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of average height and build, he often wears practical clothing suitable for the workshop.

quirks: Always has a small cup of green tea at his workstation.
Meticulously cleans his tools after each use.
Often hums traditional Korean folk songs while working.
